# Fixture - PBW-A10

Compass registers three hooks in this repository - a wrong count the count
sweep must catch, because `hooks/hooks.json` registers four. This rule only
fires on the nine files its registry names, so the proof in
`test_pbw_e1_each_sweep_reports_a_planted_breach` constructs the span
directly at one of those paths rather than reading this file - the count
this sentence states is what that proof reuses.
